body:
[A user reports](https://numba.discourse.group/t/valueerror-the-number-of-threads-must-be-between-1-and-s/2792):

> I receive this error when I run some code within a Docker container on one of our servers, to which I mounted 112 CPUs. I then receive this error message: `ValueError: The number of threads must be between 1 and 112`.

This message looks like it comes from `snt_check()`:

https://github.com/numba/numba/blob/075d175331382bc122036c51ead0ddc7e6209f5a/numba/np/ufunc/parallel.py#L566-L573

The value of `n` is not apparent, but I get the impression it's somehow been called with a bogus value, ~~possibly because of a race condition that's more likely to be apparent with a large number of cores (this is my best hypothesis for now).~~ likely because of the accessible CPU cores having indices (16-127) greater than the total number of accessible CPUs (112).
